apply.title: CMU - Apply as an International Undergraduate Student

aid.title: CMU - International Undergraduate Student Costs & Scholarships

test_policy.notes: CDS C8 (fall 2027): SAT/ACT are not required for admission but considered if submitted. International admission needs transcripts and proof of English; the SAT (EBRW 520) or ACT (English 21) can be used to meet the English requirement.

requirements.notes: Apply with CMU's own application or the Common App (CMU's Common App code is shown on the page as Central27). The $55 non-refundable fee is waived through Oct 31 of the 2026 fall season; the page does not say what the fee will be for later applicants. Currently enrolled high-school students need grade 9-11 transcripts for a decision and must graduate before starting. CMU's international page reports a 52.8% acceptance rate for international freshmen in fall 2023.

deadlines.label: International preferred admission date, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Page recommends applying by May 15 for fall (late August) and Oct 1 for spring. No hard deadline is printed. Year assumed for fall 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for applicants from a list of English-speaking countries (list on the apply page), graduates of a US high school with at least 3 years of attendance, or completion of English-medium secondary or post-secondary study, or 24+ graded post-secondary credits at a 2.50 GPA from an English-medium institution. Other proofs: IB English HL 5, AP English 4, GCSE A or B, MET 52, ELS Level 112. Scores are valid two years. The page lists scores 'for regular admission', but does not describe a conditional-admission route.

cost.notes: CMU's international undergraduate estimate for 2026-27 (24 credits, on-campus housing with a meal plan): tuition and fees $22,050, living expenses $17,596, health insurance $1,600; total $41,246. First-years must live on campus for two years.

aid.notes: Automatic merit awards by GPA, no separate application: International President's Award (3.3+ GPA) gives the U.S. resident tuition rate (about $9,144 per year saved); International Scholar Award (3.0-3.29) $4,000 per year for 4 years; International Opportunity Award (2.8-2.9) $1,000 per year for 4 years. Proof of English is required; government-sponsored students are not eligible. CMU says 34% of eligible international freshmen do not pay the full international rate. The competitive Centralis scholarship can cover tuition, fees and housing.

sat.note: CMU's international pages do not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: CMU's international pages do not print an ACT code; look it up at act.org.
